title: Audit Summary (v1)
description: Response contract for GET /api/v1/audit/summary (SPEC-046 R-1). Deterministic aggregates over envelope columns only — event_type, outcome, service, username; the details payload is never excavated (Q-3). Every list section sorts count descending, then name ascending. The decision_chain projects the SPEC-037 decision-to-execution lineage with explicit zeros, so governance can reconcile approvals against executions without reading the type table.

total_events.description: Total number of stored envelopes matching the applied filters (no default window; the store is retention-bounded).

window.description: Echo of the applied filters; unset fields are omitted. Keys are the query-route filter dimensions; since/until are RFC 3339 strings.

by_service.description: Event counts grouped by emitting service.

top_actors.description: The ten busiest non-null usernames with event counts.

decision_chain.description: SPEC-037 lineage projection; each count is zero when the event type is absent from the window.
